display.purpose: Hero headline only, one per page. Chakra Petch italic uppercase.

headline.purpose: Section titles (cyber-h2), often stroke-only with a left-to-right color drain on boot.

body.purpose: All reading copy, set in JetBrains Mono. Measure capped ~60-70ch.

label.purpose: Eyebrow pills, HUD readouts, status lines, nav links. The machine print.

shadows.name: cta-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary button resting magenta halo; intensifies to 0 0 70px / 0.6 alpha on hover.

shadows.name: focus-glow
shadows.purpose: Spine dots, pill dots, and focus states glow in their own accent.

shadows.name: text-glow
shadows.purpose: Headline stroke and stylized type emit a soft accent bloom (text-shadow).

shadows.name: orb-wash
shadows.purpose: Ambient per-section atmosphere behind content; sits behind, never under surfaces.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Reveal fades and button state transitions; the system's default exponential ease-out.

motion.name: ease-section-entrance
motion.purpose: Section boot choreography: pill rise, h2 slide, sub lift, card stagger.

motion.name: ease-drain
motion.purpose: Headline color-drain sweep on section boot.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The conversion CTA: angular bevels, solid magenta fill on dark text, resting neon glow, white-flip on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 18px 30px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.32em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; background: #ff2d92; color: #050507; border: 1px solid #ff2d92; box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(255,45,146,0.35); clip-path: polygon(8% 0, 100% 0, 100% 75%, 92% 100%, 0 100%, 0 25%); transition: color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ffffff; color: #ff2d92; box-shadow: 0 0 70px rgba(255,45,146,0.6); } .ds-btn-primary .ds-btn-arrow { transition: transform 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-btn-arrow { transform: translate(4px, -4px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action: barely-there fill, faint border, cyan reveal on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 18px 30px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.32em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.22); clip-path: polygon(8% 0, 100% 0, 100% 75%, 92% 100%, 0 100%, 0 25%); transition: color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #00f3ff; border-color: #00f3ff; background: rgba(0,243,255,0.05); }

components.name: Eyebrow Pill
components.description: The branded section kicker: mono caps in the section accent, hand-drawn corner brackets, pulsing dot.
components.css: .ds-pill { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 9px 16px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.4em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #00f3ff; background: rgba(0,243,255,0.04); border: 1px solid rgba(0,243,255,0.3); } .ds-pill::before, .ds-pill::after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 8px; height: 8px; border: 1px solid currentColor; } .ds-pill::before { top: -2px; left: -2px; border-right: 0; border-bottom: 0; } .ds-pill::after { bottom: -2px; right: -2px; border-left: 0; border-top: 0; } .ds-pill-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; box-shadow: 0 0 12px currentColor; animation: ds-pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.35; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-pill-dot { animation: none; } }

components.name: Card
components.description: Sharp, translucent console panel. Flat at rest; hover tints the border and reveals a left accent bar plus a corner meta-label.
components.html:
01

PERSISTENT MEMORY

The agent remembers across sessions, writing to memory/ in your own vault.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; background: rgba(8,8,14,0.78); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); padding: 1.4rem 1.5rem; transition: border-color 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(0,243,255,0.35); background: rgba(8,8,14,0.7); } .ds-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -1px; bottom: -1px; left: -1px; width: 2px; background: #00f3ff; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.25s ease; } .ds-card:hover::before { opacity: 0.8; } .ds-card-meta { position: absolute; top: 12px; right: 14px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.3em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); transition: color 0.25s ease; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-meta { color: #00f3ff; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Chakra Petch', sans-serif; font-style: italic; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #fff; } .ds-card-desc { margin: 10px 0 0; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 1.65; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); } .ds-card-desc code { color: #00f3ff; background: rgba(0,243,255,0.08); padding: 0 4px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: The waitlist email field: black translucent fill, hairline border, sharp corners, accent focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); padding: 14px 16px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13px; color: #fff; letter-spacing: 0.02em; transition: border-color 0.25s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00f3ff; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #00f3ff; } .ds-input:focus:not(:focus-visible) { outline: none; border-color: #00f3ff; }

components.name: Command Box
components.description: The install-command surface, the most conversion-critical element. Magenta prompt, mono command, gradient left bar, cyan-confirm copy button.
components.html: $brew install onebrain-ai/onebrain/onebrain
components.css: .ds-cmd { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 14px 14px 14px 22px; max-width: 520px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; transition: border-color 0.25s ease; } .ds-cmd:hover { border-color: rgba(0,243,255,0.4); } .ds-cmd::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -1px; bottom: -1px; left: -1px; width: 3px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ff2d92, #00f3ff); } .ds-cmd-prompt { color: #ff2d92; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-cmd-text { flex: 1; font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-cmd-copy { padding: 7px 12px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); font-family: inherit; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.22em; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-cmd-copy:hover { color: #00f3ff; border-color: #00f3ff; background: rgba(0,243,255,0.05); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Header navigation link: mono caps, muted at rest, white with bracket reveal on hover/active.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a1a1aa; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.25s ease; } .ds-nav-bracket { opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.25s ease; pointer-events: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link.is-active { color: #fff; } .ds-nav-link:hover .ds-nav-bracket, .ds-nav-link.is-active .ds-nav-bracket { opacity: 1; }

narrative.overview: OneBrain's surface is a live mission-control console for a thinking machine. You don't read this site so much as sit at its controls: HUD readouts pin the four corners, a scroll-progress spine tracks your position on the right edge, telemetry ticks in a live agent feed, and each section boots with a one-shot scanline sweep before it reveals itself. The aesthetic is operator-grade and unmistakably alive, rendered in light-on-void: near-black panels, monospace status lines, and a neon signal palette that glows rather than shines. This is a developer-facing instrument, not a marketing brochure: high, deliberate density, every readout concrete (real commands, real vault paths, real-feeling telemetry) so a skeptical engineer can see the machine work instead of reading adjectives about it. The treatment is a strong hypothesis, not a cage: hold the register (operator-grade, living, candid) fixed; the neon-and-scanline execution is open to revision if a sharper direction better earns the install and the star.
keyCharacteristics: Light-on-void: near-black (#050507) surfaces, neon signal accents that glow.
Angular, never rounded: rectangular surfaces have zero radius; bevels come from clip-path cuts.
Monospace as the speaking voice: reading copy is JetBrains Mono, not the sans.
Living HUD: corner readouts, scroll-spine, scanline boots, live telemetry, warp transitions.
Italic uppercase display type (Chakra Petch) for every headline.
Per-section accent rotation across a four-color neon family.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Fill Rule
rules.body: Accents earn their saturation by glowing (neon stroke, blurred orb, box-shadow halo), never by flooding a large surface. A neon color filling more than a button-sized area is a bug; the void is what makes the signal read.

rules.name: The Per-Section Accent Rule
rules.body: Each section owns one accent via the --section-accent custom property, rotating through the four-color family. Within a section that one accent is law; do not mix two signal colors except where the system already pairs them.

rules.name: The Living-Floor Rule
rules.body: Reading copy never goes lighter than rgba(255,255,255,0.62) on void; that is the muted floor, not a starting point. Push toward Signal White for anything a user must read. The input placeholder at rgba(255,255,255,0.22) is the known weak spot to fix, not a pattern to copy.

rules.name: The Monospace Voice Rule
rules.body: Reading copy is JetBrains Mono, not the sans. The terminal voice is the brand; do not swap body prose to Inter for readability, widen line-height instead.

rules.name: The Stencil Rule
rules.body: Headlines are Chakra Petch, italic, uppercase, every time. Never set a headline in body mono or in roman/non-italic Chakra Petch; the italic stencil is the brand's headline signature.

rules.name: The No-Lift Rule
rules.body: No surface casts a gray drop shadow. The only box-shadow in the system is a colored glow on active/accent elements. If a card looks like it's floating on a 2014 app shadow, delete the shadow and let tonal layering carry the depth.

dos: Do keep every rectangular surface sharp (border-radius: 0); express angularity through clip-path bevels, never rounded corners.
Do set headlines in Chakra Petch, italic, uppercase, and reading copy in JetBrains Mono. Honor the Monospace Voice and Stencil rules.
Do give each section exactly one accent via --section-accent and let accents glow rather than fill.
Do hold body text to >=4.5:1 (AA floor) and push toward AAA where the palette allows; treat rgba(255,255,255,0.62) as the muted floor and fix the input placeholder up to it.
Do show the machine, real commands, real vault paths, live telemetry, over adjectives. Make the hero earn the install in one screen.
Do ship a prefers-reduced-motion path for every animation and keep effects from gating content visibility.
donts: Don't use generic-SaaS scaffolding: rounded-card grids, soft purple gradients, Inter-on-white, the big-number hero-metric template, or mascot illustrations.
Don't let it read like a rival note tool (Notion, Mem, Reflect, or Obsidian's own marketing). The wedge is the agent that learns you, not prettier notes.
Don't drift corporate/enterprise: no navy-and-gray, no stock photography, no buzzword sales copy, no trust-badge soup.
Don't add gray drop shadows for depth; the only shadow is a neon glow on accents.
Don't nest cards inside cards, or flood a neon accent across a large surface.
Don't set headlines in body mono or roman Chakra Petch, and don't swap reading copy to a sans for readability.
Don't turn the eyebrow pill into a generic per-section all-caps kicker; it is one branded system element, used consistently.
